Whether the designation is Senior Associate, Counsel, Partner, or Practice Head, supervising people eventually becomes part of the role. Yet one of the least discussed transitions in a lawyer's career is the point at which legal expertise alone is no longer enough. As attorneys move into senior positions, they are expected to train junior attorneys, provide direction, and shape the day-to-day experience of those around them.
